rule_ids: A finding's rule id is the id at the start of its Schematron message: AKN-n for a numbered rule of the profile, or the section number (5.1.2) for a requirement the profile states without one. AKN-1 is a failure against the Akoma Ntoso XML Schema; a document that fails it is not checked further. sidecar-schema is a failure against schema/sidecar.schema.json; sidecar-document is a sidecar that disagrees with its document.

provenance.human-curated: A person checked it against the primary source. Ground truth: where it disagrees with any other vector, it wins.
provenance.hand-checked: Taken from a worked example in the spec.
provenance.engine-output: Taken from an implementation's tests or output; it shows what an implementation does, not what is correct.
provenance.spec-derived: Constructed from the spec's rules to exercise one rule; not yet checked by a person.

documents.jsonl.checks: Apply ops, in order, to a copy of base. A validator running the Akoma Ntoso XML Schema and then the Schematron reports exactly the rule ids in expect (an empty list: the document is valid).

fields.base: path of the document to edit, from the repository root
fields.ops: list of edits. Each has op and xpath (XPath 1.0 with the prefixes in namespaces; it selects one or more elements, and the edit applies to each). set: set attribute attr (prefix:name for a namespaced one) to value. unset: remove attribute attr. remove: remove the element. append: add the elements in xml as its last children. after: insert the elements in xml as its following siblings. Unprefixed elements in xml are in the Akoma Ntoso namespace and cx: is bound
fields.expect: sorted rule ids the result fails

sidecars.jsonl.checks: Apply patch (RFC 6902; add, remove and replace only) to base. When document is not null, apply ops to it as in documents.jsonl. A validator reports exactly the rule ids in expect: sidecar-schema from the JSON Schema; otherwise, given the document, sidecar-document if the sidecar disagrees with it.

fields.base: path of the sidecar to patch
fields.document: path of the document the sidecar indexes, or null to check the sidecar alone
fields.ops: optional edits to document, as in documents.jsonl

no-text.akn.xml.checks: A valid document for a decision with no released text (profile section 13.1), constructed from examples/minimal; base for documents.jsonl vectors.

no-text.sidecar.json.checks: The sidecar of no-text.akn.xml; base for sidecars.jsonl vectors.
